title: When They Refuse a Coat | Parenting Rewind
description:
You are late, it is cold, and your child suddenly hates every coat they own. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: You are late, it is cold, and your child suddenly hates every coat they own. Debating whether they should feel cold pulls you into a power struggle about their body. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. State the boundary and offer two workable options: The coat comes with us; wear it now or carry it to the car. Keep health and safety limits firm while leaving a small piece of control with the child.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Steps for Giving Good Directions

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
